title: Ocean Rentals

services.name: surf camp
services.desc: Chica Surf Camps are 2-day camps led by our experienced surf instructors. These have a similar format to our co-ed Surf Camp, but this one is just for the girls and ladies. We offer 9 different sessions throughout the summer. Our surf instructors will teach you how to paddle, catch waves, stand up and surf. You will be guided through beach and weather education and safety, surfing etiquette, equipment knowledge and learning how to read the tides, rip currents and swells. All Chica Surf Camp sessions will be held at Little Island Park at the south end of Sandbridge in Virginia Beach (3820 Sandpiper Rd). services.name: Boat Dock Rentals
services.desc: Enjoy all the beauty Back Bay offers with a single-day rental of a standup paddleboard (SUP), single kayak, or double kayak. Your paddling adventure begins when you launch your rental directly from our private boat dock behind our shop. Follow canals that guide you through wooded areas with dappled sunlight to open and wider trails lined with strands of tall grasses before eventually reaching Back Bay and its vast waters. Along the way, you will experience the beauty of this area rich with flora and fauna. Paddles, backrests, and lifejackets are all included.
